components.css: .ds-retro-cta { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #2b0a00; background: #2b0a00; color: #fff0d6; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #ff5a36; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-retro-cta:hover { transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1.5deg); } .ds-retro-cta:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #ff5a36; } .ds-retro-cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #ffe600; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-filter-chip { font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid #fff0d6; background: #280e4a; color: #fff0d6; transform: rotate(-2deg); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out, background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-filter-chip.ds-active, .ds-filter-chip:hover { background: #ffe600; color: #12060b; border-color: #ffe600; transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.04); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #ffe600; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Sonder's visual system inherits the tactile indie-arcade DNA of nidhishh.github.io/portfolio-website/ to solve a specific psychological problem in urban Indian online dating: live calling feels intimidating when framed like a corporate video conference, yet unsafe when framed like an anonymous chat roulette. By combining warm rounded display typography (Fredoka), 8-bit hardware timers (Press Start 2P), readable CRT narrative text (VT323), and neo-brutalist 4px ink borders with hard offset shadows, the interface turns a 3-minute voice vibe check into a low-stakes, high-trust game stage.
keyCharacteristics: Stage-Driven Palette Shifting: Warm Daylight Vermilion (#ff5a36) and Butter Cream (#fff0d6) for verification and curiosity, transitioning into Late-Night Arcade Violet (#1a0033) and Coin Gold (#ffe600) for the 9-11 PM queue and 3-minute voice call.
Tactile Neo-Brutalist Geometry: Solid 3px-4px borders paired with zero-blur hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0 to 10px 10px 0) that physically depress when clicked.
Procedural Pixel Art & Live Waveforms: Real-time 8x8, 16x16, and 32x32 canvas pixel sprites paired with animated SVG heartbeat/voice polylines and authored geometric SVG icons.
Zero-Rejection & Zero-PII Transparency: One-sided hearts remain visually private, and pre-call camera checks operate locally at 32x32 pixel resolution.

rules.name: The Zero-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary and muted text must always be tinted from the active surface's hue (#6e2811 on Butter Cream, #d6b8ff on Arcade Violet, #7be0a8 on Terminal Obsidian)—never desaturated gray.

rules.name: The Day-to-Night Funnel Rule
rules.body: Screens 1-2 use the warm Vermilion/Cream daylight register (#ff5a36 / #fff0d6) to lower onboarding anxiety; Screens 3-4 switch the phone shell into Dark Violet (#120624) bordered in Coin-Op Yellow (#ffe600) to signal entry into the 9-11 PM Live Hour.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) never carry a small eyebrow or kicker label stacked directly above them; status pills sit inline inside a horizontal topbar beside the heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every countdown timer (03:00), queue wait readout (18 sec), and North Star metric (1.44) enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so numerals never jitter during 1-second ticks.

rules.name: The Physical Press Rule
rules.body: Interactive buttons with offset block shadows translate toward their shadow on hover/active or tilt slightly using exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

dos: Do use authored inline <svg> icons from the unified geometric sprite sheet and procedural <canvas> pixel art (image-rendering: pixelated).
Do use exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) or steps(2) for retro state transitions.
Do keep one-sided heart taps visually indistinguishable from no-tap outcomes on Screen 5 to honor Sonder's zero-rejection product rule.
Do keep all verification and location data 100% synthetic (Zero-PII token, 32x32 local pixel preview, coarse city zones).
donts: Don't place small kicker or eyebrow labels above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't use raw Unicode emoji or dingbat glyphs in place of SVG icons.
Don't use elastic/bounce easing, gradient text, decorative background grid overlays, or colored side-stripes (border-left > 1px).
Don't ingest or prompt for real Aadhaar numbers, government ID uploads, phone numbers, or exact GPS coordinates.
